culture-library items carry kind/title/author/sha256 and a binary visibility ('private','public', core/models.py:26, default private); no tag field exists (only OpenAPI route tags); access is per-key Principal scopes + private flag (server/auth.py:33-79); agents can already read it over its MCP/RAG endpoints; irc-lens never references the library. 'Library-tagged content' needs a new tag field + per-user principal there.

The mesh IRCd listens on all interfaces while the guest sandbox IRCd listens on loopback only, so gateway-only enforcement holds for the sandbox but not for the mesh unless the mesh port is closed to everything except the lens, the mesh's own agents and its links (now requirement c31).
